iLock_Geography
Package iLock_Geography :: Package predicate_library :: Module path_area
[frames] | no frames]

Module path_area

The module defines predicate classes that are used to populate geo predicates related to both paths and areas.

Classes
  NthAreaInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE with the user type in areaUserTypes is the nth area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
  FirstAreaInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is the first area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
  LastAreaInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is the last area in path of type PATH_TYPE.
  PathInArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if path of type PATH_TYPE is in area of type AREA_TYPE.
  PathIntersectsArea
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if path of type PATH_TYPE intersects with area of type AREA_TYPE.
  PathIntersectsIndexedArea
  AreaBeforePath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is before path of type PATH_TYPE, which means the start node of path is in area.
  AreaAfterPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area)' if area of type AREA_TYPE is after path of type PATH_TYPE, which means the end node of path is in area.
  AreaAfterAreaInPath
Predicate class that builds true point '(path, area_1, area_2)' if area_1 and area_2 of type AREA_TYPE with the user type in areaUserTypes are in path of type PATH_TYPE and area_2 is next to area_1.

Imports: RailyardFactory, alg, GeoPredicate, PATH_TYPE, AREA_TYPE, GENERIC_OUTSIDE_TYPE, geoAssert, stringIterable2set, typedoc
